title: Finite-Horizon Portfolio Choice, Labor Supply, and Early Retirement under Borrowing Constraints
summary: We study a finite-horizon optimal consumption and portfolio problem with labor supply flexibility and an irreversible early retirement option under a borrowing constraint. The agent chooses consumption, risky investment, and leisure before retirement, while after retirement labor income disappears and leisure is fixed at its maximal level. Preferences are described by a Cobb--Douglas utility, and wealth must remain nonnegative. {Using a dual martingale method, we transform the primal problem into a zero-sum stopper--singular-controller game.
